searchText: We just tested a bit and it looks like go-ethereum, lighthouse and trinity implement the same spec and can all talk to each other I tried using the nimbus testnet1 bootnode and it doesn't respond to the handshake correctly, the clients never progress beyond whoareyou in the handshake Wooh! *insert Corona virus joke about handshake problems
